specs.title: Mera passkey account: create, sign out, sign in again to the same address
session survives navigation, direct URLs, reload, a new tab and viewport changes
after a reload the account is locked, not signed out, and the passkey unlocks signing once
a cancelled passkey prompt never signs the user out
switching accounts in another tab shows the new account, locked, in this tab
a corrupted saved credential does not block unlocking
signing out while a passkey prompt is open is not undone when the prompt completes
authenticator without PRF gets PRF_UNAVAILABLE and no account
no development mock account outside the local network
unmeasured mainnet results show PENDING, never zero
proof page labels local and simulated results as such
landing keeps proof out of the hero and states what is not yet proven
proof page shows the measured contract rejection
internal links resolve (no broken links)
market-data proxy only serves allowlisted read paths
rpc proxy forwards reads only and keeps the two providers separate
terminal shows live market data or an explicit unavailable state, never fake data
order ticket refuses to submit without a desk and explains why
leverage above the cap is shown against the 5.00x maximum
positions tab does not claim a flat desk when there is no desk
